observations.text: Engine room garbage drums to be fitted with self-closing arrangements

positives: Inspector was very well behaved and gentlemanly
style: Starts engine room rounds from the bottom platform and works up
Tests alarms and equipment himself, asks ETO to try emergency steering
Asks management level questions on PMS
Spends time with junior engineers and ratings on procedures

summary: Engine room inspection by Capt Rohit Gullani on 11 Feb 2026, port given as Alma petroli. He was calm and polite, walked the engine room from the bottom platform up, tested bilge, OWS, leak off and ODM alarms and emergency steering, and questioned the second engineer on PMS and management level topics. One observation was raised on engine room garbage drums needing self-closing arrangements.
